decided: New files the project's ignore list excludes are never committed, and each new file a commit adds is named in one line as it lands. A file git already tracks is a different case, decided in its own entry.
alternatives: commit every new file without naming it
commit only files git already tracks
why: Committing everything means a stray scratch or credentials file could be pushed; the ignore list is the project's own boundary, and naming each new file lets the user catch a stray at once.
